Wahapedia Aeldari page (Factions.csv AE, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/aeldari), Harlequins subfaction (CWHA, parent_id AE). Groups: Codex: Aeldari's general stratagems and the Harlequins and Masque ones; not the Vigilus Defiant Windrider Host and Wraith Host Specialist Detachments, which need a Craftworlds Detachment. Ids: only the stratagems its units (Troupe, Troupe Master, Death Jester, Shadowseer, Solitaire, Skyweavers, Voidweavers, Starweaver) can use, read from each stratagem's text: every Harlequins and Masque stratagem, and the general ones open to HARLEQUINS units, a SHADOWSEER or shuriken weapons. General stratagems that need ASURYANI-only or Craftworld units (Farseer, Warlocks, Aspect Warriors, Guardians, Wraith constructs, Fire Prisms, Phoenix Lords, Exarchs, serpent shields) are dropped. The HARLEQUIN'S KISS/EMBRACE/CARESS stratagems are kept: Solitaire carries the KISS and CARESS keywords, and Troupe models carry those weapons.

No Wahapedia faction of its own. Its Obsidius Mallex and Black Legionnaires are HERETIC ASTARTES and BLACK LEGION (BSData Chaos - Servants of the Abyss.cat), so the Wahapedia Chaos Space Marines page (CSM) with the Black Legion subfaction (LGBL, parent_id CSM), group Black Legion only, then ids: only the stratagems its units can use, read from each stratagem's text. The Chaos Space Marines group is left out because no unit has TRAITORIS ASTARTES, CORE, LEGIONARIES or CULTISTS (BSData and Wahapedia Datasheets_keywords.csv agree), which every stratagem in it needs (and no Mark of Chaos, Fallen Angels, Cogs of Vashtorr or Vigilus Ablaze units either). Its only BLACK LEGION CHARACTER, Obsidius Mallex, is named, which rules out Lord of the Ezekarion. That leaves Confluence of Traitors, Tip of the Spear, Unrelenting Onslaught and Vengeful Skies.

No Wahapedia faction of its own. Its Primaris Psyker and Astropath are ASTRA MILITARUM (BSData Imperium - Adeptus Astra Telepathica.cat) and sit on the Wahapedia Astra Militarum page (Factions.csv AM); no regiment subfactions. Ids: only the stratagems those two units can use, read from each stratagem's text (its links to Astra Militarum and the other catalogues in its roster scope have importRootEntries="false", so a roster can take only these two units). Both are ASTRA MILITARUM CHARACTER INFANTRY PSYKER units with no CORE, PLATOON, OFFICER, REGIMENTAL or regiment keyword, so they can use Acceptable Losses, Vicious Traps, Officer Cadre and Imperial Commander’s Armoury. The Vigilus Defiant Specialist Detachment stratagems (Emperor’s Blade, Emperor’s Conclave, Emperor’s Fist, Emperor’s Wrath, Tempestus Drop Force) are dropped: none of their listed units is in this catalogue.

Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/space-marines) with no chapter subfaction: Legion of the Damned units have no <CHAPTER> (BSData Imperium - Legion of the Damned.cat: Adeptus Astartes, Imperium, Legion of the Damned). Group Adeptus Astartes only, then ids: only the stratagems its one unit can use, read from each stratagem's text. Damned Legionnaires are ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY with no CORE, <CHAPTER>, CHARACTER, PRIMARIS, PHOBOS or TERMINATOR keyword and no heavy bolter or missile launcher, so they can use Auspex Scan, Death to the Traitors!, Steady Advance and Uncompromising Fire, and Orbital Bombardment (a pure Legion army with no CHARACTER can make a Legionnaire its WARLORD: 01_Core_Rules/Army_Building_Detachments_and_CP.md).
